FROM THE
PRESIDENT
Dear Brothers,

At is with great pleasure and pride that this entire special
issue of the DIAMOND is devoted to a report of the
success ofthe 1987-88 Annual Giving program. And suc

cessful it was!

In a year of some economic uncertainty (who can forget
October 19, 1987?), 2,435 of Psi Upsilon's most loyal
alumni contributed a record $153,358 to the Annual Giv
ing program. Thanks to this unprecedented generosity,
the Fraternity was able to maintain its traditionally high
standards, broaden its undergraduate educational pro
grams, and enhance its services to chapters, while stUl
balancing its operating budget.
This enthusiastic response is truly heartwarming. The
Executive Council extends its warmest and most sincere
appreciation to every alumnus who participated in this
year's Annual Giving program for the strong show of faith
in Psi Upsilon's future. It is through such generous sup

port that we can continue to extend the warm hand of
brotherhood to yet another generation of undergradu
ates.

Yours in the bonds.

Wilham R. Robie, Epsilon Omega '66
President of the Executive Council
